name: Kin'weelay
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Kin'weelay brings Darkspear witchcraft to the Horde's effort to free young Yenniku. His knowledge of spirits guides the work in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: A Master of Darkspear Mojo
sections.body: Kin'weelay is a powerful Darkspear witch doctor who knows spirits, hexes, and soul magic. Horde scouts seek his counsel in Stranglethorn Vale when ancestral spirits stir or hostile troll enchantments block their way.

sections.title: The Mission to Grom'gol
sections.body:
Kin'weelay was sent south from Orgrimmar to support Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp. He works to break the bindings on Yenniku, the abducted son of Chieftain Vol'jin's trusted bloodline.

To undo the dark craft, Kin'weelay seeks powerful reagents, especially the Mind's Eye. He means to shape a soul gem that can free captured spirits.

faq.answer: At Grom'gol Base Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Kin'weelay is a Darkspear troll witch doctor. Horde leaders sent him from Orgrimmar for his mastery of spiritual and soul magic.

faq.q: Why is Kin'weelay in Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay came to Grom'gol Base Camp to aid Nimboya and the local Darkspear expedition. He brings his mystical talents to the effort to find and restore young Yenniku from the hostile jungle trolls.

faq.q: What is Kin'weelay trying to create?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay seeks to make a soul gem from the Mind's Eye. He means it to capture and preserve Yenniku's soul, freeing the boy from the dark control upon him.
Kin'weelay came from Orgrimmar, where the Darkspear have had strong ties and a presence since joining the Horde and settling the Echo Isles.

faq.q: How does he view the other troll tribes of Stranglethorn?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay sees hostile jungle tribes such as the Bloodscalp and Skullsplitter as dangerous rivals. Their rituals are violent and corrupted, so he uses his craft against their charms and to recover stolen Darkspear youth.

faq.q: What kind of items does Kin'weelay study?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay studies local curiosities with natural or hexed resonance, including singing crystals and the bone necklaces worn by hostile jungle trolls. He examines their mojo to devise countermeasures.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can look to Kin'weelay as one of your tribe's respected spiritual authorities. He works to undo the cruel curses of your jungle kin.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how troll spiritualism aids the war effort. Kin'weelay offers magical ways to counter threats that strength alone cannot break.
